title: MMORPG Playtest
description: What a playtest operator watches: players, shard availability, the fixed-tick budget, network health, the worker process, and recent warnings.

panels.title: Players
panels.description: Joined real players on the selected workers.

panels.title: Bots
panels.description: Joined synthetic bots on the selected workers.

panels.title: Shards online
panels.description: Shards that the public shard list reports online.

panels.title: Tick p99
panels.description: 99th percentile fixed-tick duration over five minutes. The budget at 30 Hz is 33.3 ms.

panels.title: Overruns (5 min)
panels.description: Ticks in the last five minutes that took longer than the tick interval.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx
panels.description: Share of GameService requests that failed with a 5xx status over five minutes.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Number of alert rules that fire right now.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts from observability/prometheus/rules that fire right now. All rules and their state are under Alerting > Alert rules.

panels.title: Tick duration
panels.description: Fixed-tick duration percentiles per one-minute window against the 33.3 ms budget of a 30 Hz tick.

panels.title: Tick phases (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of each tick phase. Snapshot broadcast includes the interest phase.

panels.title: Tick lag, overruns, and resynchronizations
panels.description: How late ticks start (p99), ticks over budget per minute, and catch-up resynchronizations per minute.

panels.title: Backlogs
panels.description: Completed authority operations waiting for the loop, and queued corpse mutations. Both should stay near zero.

panels.title: Population
panels.description: Joined real players, synthetic bots, peers that have not joined yet, and simulated entities.

panels.title: Bandwidth
panels.description: UDP payload bytes per second. Snapshots are part of sent.

panels.title: Packets
panels.description: UDP packets per second.

panels.title: Drops and rejections
panels.description: Snapshot packets dropped by per-peer quotas or aggregate backpressure, and inbound packets over quota, per second.

panels.title: Joins and connections
panels.description: Accepted and rejected joins and rejected UDP connections per minute.

panels.title: Calls to GameService
panels.description: Worker HTTP calls to GameService: p95 latency in seconds and failures per minute.

panels.title: World actors
panels.description: NPC and Mob population by activity tier.

panels.title: Interactions
panels.description: Open interaction leases and accepted and rejected interactions per minute.

panels.title: Corpses on the worker
panels.description: Active live and durable corpses held by the worker.

panels.title: Gathering
panels.description: Players gathering at resource nodes, depleted nodes waiting for respawn, and gathering cycles per minute by outcome.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Process CPU time per second, in cores.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set and the managed heap after the last collection.

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Managed bytes allocated per second. The fixed tick should not drive this.

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: Collections per minute by generation and GC pause time per second.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Warning and error log entries of both services. Open an entry and follow its trace id to the trace in Tempo.
